note: Per-card completed eBay auction stats for One Piece Card Game singles, derived from the daily auction archive (data/auction-archive/). medPrice is the median final winning bid per card (USD), sellThrough is the share of decided auctions that actually sold, medBids/medBidders show bidding competition. Cards with fewer than 3 confirmed sales are omitted rather than shown on thin samples. This is a rolling snapshot recomputed from the last 45 days of the archive; those daily files are the source of truth for individual sales.
